meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)
to reach, walk as far as

examples.trans: You need to hold your breath for a long time.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.en: to jam, to get stuck, to seize up
meanings.note: Often impersonal: дверь заклинило. Colloquially of a person: to freeze up, get fixated (его заклинило).

examples.trans: Chef, Lyova's frozen up on us.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: From Latin 'inspector' (observer, overseer, from 'inspicere', to look into).

examples.text: Инспекторы ищут нарушения только ради денег.
examples.trans: Inspectors look for violations only for money.
The inspector is checking the kitchen.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.
Viktor Petrovich is in a coma.
You only recently came out of a coma.

examples.text: Два месяца назад он был в коме.
examples.trans: Two months ago he was in a coma.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: + accusative; за + accusative for the reason.

examples.trans: What are you punishing me for?

examples.text: Ладно, сильно не наказывай, они просто ошиблись.
examples.trans: All right, don't punish them too hard, they just made a mistake.

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

находиться.gloss: to be located, to be found

meanings.en: to be located, to be situated

examples.trans: Where is the operating room located?
The town is situated on a river.
Where is the operating room located here?

examples.text: Аркаш, ну что скажешь? Когда начинать?
examples.trans: Arkasha, so what do you say? When do I start?

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Нина, не слушай. Это опять обман.
examples.trans: Nina, don't listen. It's another trick.

meanings.en: to rig, frame, set up maliciously

examples.trans: Did you set all this up in advance?
The fraudsters engineered a trap for the businessman.

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: Всё получилось = it all worked out.

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor

examples.text: Классный из тебя мэр получится, Самсон.
examples.trans: You'll make a great mayor, Samson.
No, I dressed for a funeral.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.
We'll definitely have a big wedding!

examples.text: Макс, зачем ты соврал про нашу будущую свадьбу?
examples.trans: Max, why did you lie about our future wedding?
Then a wedding, and then kids!

meanings.note: заработать состояние = to make a fortune

examples.trans: Checking the condition of the wall.

examples.text: Эксперты уже начали проверку состояния старой стены.
examples.trans: Experts have already begun checking the condition of the old wall.
His condition is stable but serious.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: in weight, or тяжёлый металл = heavy metal

examples.text: Я вообще в школе тяжёлый металл любила!
examples.trans: In school I actually loved heavy metal!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
